priorities.summary: Cognition before 0.13.0 defaults its agent sandbox backend to local execution and ships no authentication on its REST/SSE API, letting unauthenticated attackers run arbitrary shell commands as the server process.
Vanus 0.8.0 through 0.9.0 ships a hardcoded admin token, letting unauthenticated remote attackers gain cluster-admin access over the gateway gRPC proxy and manage namespaces, users, and events.

Rank Math SEO PRO suffered a supply-chain compromise: a subset of version 3.0.123 packages downloaded or updated between Oct 15 20:02 UTC and Oct 16 07:12 UTC contained malware — reinstall clean packages now.

model.name: Inception Mercury 3
model.summary: Inception's flagship diffusion LLM claims to outperform GPT-6 Luna and Claude Haiku 5.5 on benchmarks while generating 1,068 tokens per second — evidence that text-diffusion architectures can scale to frontier quality with a 1M-token context window.
